title: Implement and accept Mac default-profile service lifecycle
goal: Use the owner-selected Mac NERV-01 default profile to deliver ownership-aware service install/update/uninstall and durable recovery; retain data/configuration/keys
acceptance: Owner selected Mac default profile; no need to ask that scope decision again. Read-only baseline: current/legacy definitions/registrations absent and configured API not responsive; recheck before effects
Implement reviewed service ownership/path/session/source checks and fenced durable receipts/resource lifecycle with uncertainty and explicit stopped recovery
Validate actual install/status/start/stop/update/uninstall and partial failure/replay without deleting or overwriting another definition or profile
Retain data, keys and config; do not install a second isolated-profile service, system daemon or linger
A default installation is the chosen test target, not mandatory for F-005 closure; broader platform and multi-device acceptance remains explicit
validation: Meaningful cross-boundary ownership/session/effect/journal/recovery tests, applicable static/build/headless checks and final CI
Explicit actual Mac service evidence with baseline, changed state and retained data; mocks and merge are not actual OS acceptance
escalation: Pause for changed/foreign service ownership, live/uncertain descendants, missing session or conflicting active work
Root activation belongs to T05; service target selection does not authorize dropping trust/history or replaying physical actions
